title: PADE DevelopmentSession
description: v1alpha1 Intent document for a portable DevelopmentSession (conventionally pade.yaml). Uses Kubernetes-style apiVersion/kind/metadata/spec grammar without requiring Kubernetes. The apiVersion group pade.local and this $id are exploratory identifiers (not hosted URLs); .local avoids claiming a public DNS domain. Portable intent only — no provider bindings, secrets, broker URLs, or status. See spec/intent.md and docs/manifest-conventions.md.

apiVersion.description: Provisional API group/version for the Intent wire format.

kind.description: Resource kind. DevelopmentSession declares portable development-session intent.

name.description: DNS-1123 subdomain-ish identifier for this Intent document. Not Kubernetes ObjectMeta.

labels.description: Optional portable labels. Not API-server metadata.

annotations.description: Optional portable annotations. Not API-server metadata.

capabilities.description: Named capability requests. Values describe required authority, never credentials.

access.description: Access intent such as read or write.

provider.description: Optional binding hint for prototypes (e.g. env, vault). Prefer user/org-level bindings long term.

env.description: For provider=env demos: required environment variable names (not values).
